clinical_setting: Hereditary Breast & Ovarian Cancer Multidisciplinary Review
executive_clinical_summary: Although reported on this multigene panel as a VUS, this exonic single-nucleotide variant does not disrupt donor or acceptor motifs or alter exonic splicing enhancers. AlphaGenome predicts minimal splicing impact (0.016, Bin 1 with <1.5% empirical risk), indicating normal transcript processing. Splicing-mediated pathogenicity is excluded.

Test: Comprehensive 30-Gene Hereditary Breast & Ovarian Cancer Panel (HBOC-30) | Finding #2: NM_007294.4:c.2077G>A
AlphaGenome Score: 0.017 | Calibration: Bin 1 of 5 (1.5% PPV, 95% CI: [0.3% – 7.9%])
Assessment: Low Splicing Disruption Risk (DE-PRIORITIZE SPLICING)
Directive: ACTION: Splicing disruption is excluded as a disease mechanism. De-prioritize splicing defect. Patient should NOT undergo invasive risk-reducing prophylactic surgeries on the basis of this variant. Cancer screening should be managed based on personal clinical history and family pedigree alone.
